description: issue #691 (headless-stream self-sufficiency, extending #690's `note-tempo-change-sequence`): `set_tempo 60` then `play ["c4" 1 "e4" 2]`. `play` emits the melody's beat durations verbatim; the tempo lives in the earlier `set_tempo` event. A downstream replay tool therefore has COMPLETE information (tempo from the `set_tempo` event x beat durations from the melody) to render wall-clock timing, so no runtime beat cursor is needed - durations are carried verbatim in beats (spec/interaction-events.md:346-347), not converted at emit. Each sound event follows its instruction event.
